output.summary: A deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America from southern Michigan to central Mexico, eastern redbud bears clusters of magenta-pink flowers on bare branches and sometimes directly on its trunk. Its leaves are heart-shaped, and its fruits are flat, pea-like pods.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers are eaten fresh, fried, raw or boiled; Native Americans also eat roasted seeds. Southern Appalachian green-twig seasoning is reported with an uncited claim.
